items.title: Skyworks Solutions (SWKS) Stock Gets Fair Value Bump As Analysts Weigh Qorvo Integration
items.summary: The modeled fair value estimate for Skyworks Solutions has shifted from US$76.04 to US$78.68, reflecting an updated view of what the stock may be worth on revised assumptions. This move sits against a tighter set of Street targets in the US$90 to US$107 range, where some analysts highlight potential benefits from Qorvo integration, while others stay cautious on handset exposure and execution. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.28 per share was in line with analysts’ consensus estimates.
